title: See the model's reasoning
body: For users who have it turned on, you can now expand and read the model's step-by-step reasoning behind a reply, not just the final answer.

title: Fixed replies drifting into gibberish
body: Fixed a rare bug where a long reply could drift away from real words into a chain of loosely related synonyms instead of actual sentences. Long replies read coherently all the way through now.

title: Fixed replies that could run away and freeze chat
body: Found and fixed a bug where a single reply could occasionally spiral into an endless repetitive loop, tying up the server until someone restarted it by hand. Replies are now automatically capped so this can't happen again.

title: Download Wrike attachments from chat
body: Attachments Jabber finds on a Wrike task can now be downloaded straight from the conversation.

title: Live Sage (ERP) lookups
body: For users with it turned on, Jabber can now look up real data in Sage and bring it into its answer instead of only working from what you typed.

title: Images in chat
body: You can now paste or attach images directly into a conversation.
